role: Declares the Nether fortress structure type (MapGenNetherBridge) for the shared structure layer, the per-piece buildComponent dispatch and the per-piece addComponentParts block dispatch.
notes: The fortress piece kinds (F_*), struct piece and the fortress_weight type are declared in structure.h, not here. MapGenNetherBridge's spawnList (blaze, pig zombie, skeleton, magma cube) is not in this header; test_fortress_spawn.c suggests it lives elsewhere (not verified where).
